pictures.name: ZSB1-Goindwal-Langar
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. An open-sided langar hall in the village of Goindwal in the 1500s: long rows of people of every kind, farmers, widows, travelers, a holy man, sit cross-legged on the floor on long cloth strips, while volunteers walk the rows serving lentils and flatbread from brass buckets. Big cooking pots steam at the back. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows.

pictures.name: ZSB2-Emperor-Arrives
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. The emperor Akbar, a strong man with a dark moustache, in a richly embroidered Mughal robe, jewelled turban and sash, arrives at the simple gate of the Goindwal langar with a crowd of courtiers and guards in brocade. A humble Sikh volunteer with a covered head bows and gestures politely toward the rows of seated people inside. Contrast of silk and homespun.

pictures.name: ZSB3-Emperor-Sits
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. Inside the langar hall, the emperor Akbar, dark moustache, embroidered robe, jewelled turban, sits cross-legged on the floor in a row, between a weathered farmer and a poor old woman in a plain shawl, eating flatbread from a simple leaf plate. A volunteer serves him exactly as the others. Courtiers stand awkwardly at the edge. Gentle humor, dignity.

pictures.name: ZSB4-The-Offer
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. A simple courtyard: the emperor Akbar, dark moustache, embroidered robe, jewelled turban, holds out a rolled and sealed document, a land grant, with both hands. Before him sits the very old Guru Amar Das in plain white, seen only from behind, one hand raised gently in a kind refusal. Lamplight, quiet respect. The Guru is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.

pictures.name: ZSB6-Today-Door
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting in the same style, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern scene painted like an old master. No readable text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos. The entrance of a modern neighborhood gurdwara at dusk, a tall saffron Nishan Sahib flag on its pole outside, the door open with warm light inside. A first-time visitor in a jacket ties a borrowed orange scarf over her hair while a smiling older Sikh volunteer points to the shoe racks and a hand-washing tap. Welcoming.
